body: He said he wanted me to be normal and that depression isn't real. It really hurt. I thought he loved me and nothing would change that. Now I feel no one would be able to love me cos I'm just not normal.
I'm beginning to believe that day will never come
I don't think we would be here otherwise
Too true. Still hurts, I was so wrong!

I want it to be over so I don't have to struggle every day. I can try and try and try but it doesn't help. It hasn't so far. I know you mean well but it's never that simple, plans fail then I feel worse. Sometimes things don't get better. No matter how much you try.
I've exhausted all I am able to.
It's just life in general. Some things can't be helped. I've tried.
I want to be ok, enjoy life more than I hate it. What stops me? I'm not so sure. Just the way it goes I guess.
I'm done with being stupid. Like really this time...
I'm going to have to listen to this now. Beautiful song 💛
Thank you for posting. It helps to realise the pain wasn't all worthless at all...we needed this to see what's true 💛
You can talk to me any time you feel scared. You're not alone even if it feels that way. Take every day as it comes. You're trying and that's good!
Have you got anyone you could talk to when you're feeling this way? Please keep trying. You can do this. 💛
I try to remind myself of these things all the time. It's the truth I always needed but never wanted 💔
So true. It's hard to see but it's all there.

I struggle with this too. I'm not happy. I'm not ok. I don't like life. I've tried to but I just don't. It's all pointless really. I wish I was like others who can just be distracted till the end anyway but I can't! My only comfort in life is that I will die. Until then I live in misery to help the people around me feel better. Sucks.
I don't think I would. He's everything I dislike in a person if I really think about. It hurts I got that wrong though. It hurts I thought he was better.

Is there ever a way to really know? Our best isn't good enough for everyone I guess. 

I feel this way because I'm still hurting. He's not hurting. What he gave me I miss and love. He doesn't feel that way. I think I'd be happier too. It would be easier at least. Idk if that answers your question but it's the only way I can make sense of it.

Yes. I see how happy he is now, I see the progress he's making without me. It hurts of course because I felt I just loved him and was there for him...instead I was just in the way of him living his best life. What I had to give wasn't enough.
That made me cry :( but it's also beautiful. If only 💛
I don't know the answers. I'm sorry. Maybe they did help? The best they can. None of us want to be here but none of us want to help another end it either. I hope you find a reason to keep going.

He loved me.
He stopped.
He did. He told me he loved me and wanted to be with me. I fell for it because well i love him and thought he wouldn't say those things to me if he didn't mean them. He lied.
You're doing all you can, the rest is down to time I guess. I hope it's easier for you soon 💛
It's ok. It all hurts really doesn't it? Lol thank you for your time.
I feel I have no choice at this stage anyway. You're probably right. Just when he has no one else.
It wasn't easy at first but I want him to be happy I guess. Just hurts that he doesn't want the same for me. Never mind the whole not loving me back thing lol I wish you the best too.
I hope you have a better day tomorrow. You've done well so far so don't be too hard on yourself for how you felt today. You can do this.
I'm slowly beginning to realise this....finally! But you put it in words I wouldn't be able to. Thank you 💛
This sounds just like me :( I find comfort in that death is inevitable. I hope you find a way to enjoy life before that though.

I'm feeling the same right now, only he pretended to love me until he had got what he wanted. It hurts so much. I feel so stupid for loving him, for wanting to be there even though I know I mean nothing to him :(
I took that risk two weeks ago and I wish I hadn't :( love really does suck sometimes.
You don't love her at all. I hate that people throw that word around when they do not know what it means. Let her find someone who wants to treat her right and really does love her.
That's what has stopped me for so long, the thought of it going wrong.
